title: Growth without promotion: scope, depth and work that is visible

videos.script: Most people change level a handful of times in a whole career. {{title}} A manager who only talks about growth as promotion has nothing to say to most of the team, most of the year. {{year}} There are three other directions. Scope, owning more of the system. Depth, becoming the person who knows. And visibility, work that people outside the team can see. {{three}} Paula runs the planning meeting, onboards every new hire and keeps the runbooks current. None of it was in her last review. {{glue}} This lesson is about that work, and how to make it count. And about stretch assignments, sized so they stretch and do not break. {{stretch}}
